s3|update1.text:
# Parquet is immutable:
# read the partition file,
# change one value,
# rewrite the WHOLE file

res.query: COPY (SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN order_id = 4800000 THEN 'refunded' ELSE status END AS status) FROM read_parquet('s3://lake/orders_by_month/order_year=2025/order_month=12/*.parquet')) TO 's3://lake/scratch/rewrite.parquet' (FORMAT parquet, COMPRESSION zstd)
rows: rewrote the whole partition file: 205,479 rows to change 1 value
